messages.subject: Output about log-likelihood available in Mplus
messages.subject_clean: Output about log-likelihood available in Mplus
messages.body_plain:
Hi, thanks for such a great package - I've been using it to automatically generate (and run) Mplus models (some documentation about it in an in-development package here <https://jrosen48.github.io/tidyLPA/articles/comparing-mclust-and-mplus-output.html>).

I have a quick question about some output that is available about log-likelihood values in the context of specifying mixture models.

Some of the output, beneath the sample statistics, is labeled "RANDOM STARTS RESULTS RANKED FROM THE BEST TO THE WORST LOGLIKELIHOOD VALUES"

Here is some of what the output looks like:
>
> Final stage loglikelihood values at local maxima, seeds, and initial stage start numbers:
>
>           -16460.232  344422           296
>           -16578.712  853195           431
>           -16812.600  226322           478
>           -17647.161  153053           378
>           -17665.949  529496           343
>           -17665.949  211281           292
>           -17682.291  350608           334
>           -17699.501  425929           508
>           -17699.501  153394           429
>           -17700.219  68985            17
>           -17702.372  73576            213
>           -17707.175  575700           100
>           -17730.032  830392           35

This output does not seem to be available from the results of the readModels(). Is there a way to obtain it - or to modify some other output to obtain this?

Thanks again and Happy New Year.
JOsh

Just to keep this on our radar, could you add a feature request on Github here: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation/issues

Thanks,
Michael

messages.subject: New paper on MplusAutomation, and updated version of package
messages.subject_clean: New paper on MplusAutomation, and updated version of package
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I wanted to let you know that Josh and I recently published a paper in Structural Equation Modeling that gives an overview of the MplusAutomation package. This may be helpful for those getting up to speed on the package, or those interested in more advanced analyses such as Monte Carlo studies. You can view a pre-print version here: http://dependpsu.weebly.com/uploads/6/4/4/5/64458901/hallquist-wiley_mplusautomation_manuscript_sem_accepted_oct2017.pdf. If you find the package useful in your work, please consider citing it in your papers.

Hallquist, M. N. & Wiley, J. F. (in press). MplusAutomation: An R Package for Facilitating Large-Scale Latent Variable Analyses in Mplus. Structural Equation Modeling. doi: 10.1080/10705511.2017.1402334.

We have also made a few small updates to the package that will release as v0.7-1 on CRAN in the next few days. You can use the update.packages() function to get the latest -- it's still propagating to CRAN mirrors, but should be available shortly. The updates are listed below for reference.

Best wishes,
Michael

Version 0.7-1
- notice:       For consistency, covariance.coverage has been renamed covariance_coverage in the list returned from readModels
- notice:       extractModelSummaries and extractModelParameters have been removed in favor of readModels.
- notice:       citation to paper about MplusAutomation provided at startup
- feature:      Refactored readModels parser for identifying major sections. Speeds up function by 7-12%.
- feature:      new 'quiet' parameter for readModels to suppress progress messages.
- feature:      new 'what' parameter for readModels to specify sections to extract.
- feature:      Switch to readLines instead of scan for readModels. 1-2% speed increase.
- feature:      Add local_tmpdir argument to runModels to use location of .inp file for Mplus temporary files (useful for avoiding collisions with multiple Mplus instances)
- feature:      lookupTech1Parameter now accepts an mplus.model object, as generated by readModels()
- feature:      Support multiple groups output for MODEL INDIRECT
- bugfix:       Extract r2 output for Mplus v8 outputs using multiple imputation (has rate of missing column)
- bugfix:       Correction for false positive match on model fit information from new LCA TECH10 output.
- bugfix:       Extract delta (scale factors) vector from TECH1.
- bugfix:       Support different format of MODEL INDIRECT direct effects in v8
